user_saw: An operator could run a self-update on FreeBSD and have OpenClaw replace files or launchers managed by pkg.
summary: The fix checks FreeBSD pkg ownership at update admission and before filesystem changes, refusing updates when ownership is present or cannot be ruled out.
reasoning: The existing updater already renamed the installation root and copied launchers as part of its package-manager update flow. I checked that the previous executor required a process-start identity and failed before staging on FreeBSD, and that #147415 added the FreeBSD identity reader that let this path reach the existing replacement logic. The fix PR reports reproducing the ownership failure on unpatched source with an unowned control.
